title: Descent of the normalized global tensor comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme with its derived tensor structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and let P from modules over Gamma(X,O_X) to O_X-module sheaves be additive, strong monoidal and a left adjoint. Fix L between the derived categories and alpha:Qh L to Ph Qh. Suppose alpha is invertible on K-flat homotopy objects [def-pc-kflat-complex], and Ph preserves K-flatness. Then there are natural isomorphisms L(A tensor B) to LA tensor LB satisfying the normalization on quotient K-flat cochain objects from the totalized inverse tensor constraint of P. This asserts neither existence nor absoluteness of L.

source.place: Derived pullback tensor comparison; uniqueness of left derived bifunctors

proof.text: Form U=L composed with source derived tensor and V=target derived tensor applied to L in both arguments. Their counits are L(mu) then alpha, and alpha in both arguments then mu. They are isomorphisms on K-flat pairs since tensor preserves K-flatness, alpha is invertible there, and Ph preserves K-flatness. The K-flat derivability structure makes both left derived bifunctors.

Totalize the inverse strong tensor constraint of P and localize it. Uniqueness of left derived bifunctors descends this isomorphism. Naturality in both variables gives tensor naturality; counit compatibility gives normalization. The private generic tensorComparison_of_kflat proves the abstract argument. Specialize its monoidal and categorical parameters to the indicated homotopy and derived categories and quotient functors.
